precipitation.note: CARLA WeatherParameters precipitation. How hard it is raining.

precipitation_deposits.note: CARLA WeatherParameters precipitation_deposits. Standing water on the road.

wetness.note: CARLA WeatherParameters wetness. Water on the camera lens.

sun_altitude_angle.note: CARLA WeatherParameters sun_altitude_angle. Negative is night.

instruction_fire_distance_m.note: How close the ego has to come to config.instruction_trigger.anchor.

ga_settings.migration_note: Island model: each process runs one instruction and, at every generation barrier, imports traffic contexts whose control run finished clean in every repetition on some other island (see 05_sync_island.py). migration_count of the offspring produced by crossover and mutation are overwritten with those contexts before they are simulated. migration_target picks which offspring lose their slot: 'worst_parents' takes the ones whose two tournament-selected parents have the lowest mean fitness_differential, 'random' just draws migration_count of them -- offspring carry no fitness yet, so the ordering is only a heuristic either way. Set migration_count to 0 to run the island without importing anything.
